description: This file defines the Parameters class in the package com.fathzer.soft.javaluator, which manages evaluator parameters such as operators, functions, constants, brackets, and translations for a mathematical expression evaluator.

classes.name: Parameters
classes.description: A class representing the configuration parameters for an expression evaluator, including operators, functions, constants, brackets, and translations.

methods.name: Parameters
methods.description: Default constructor initializing empty lists for operators, functions, constants, brackets, and a default comma function separator.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns a collection of supported operators.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns a collection of supported functions.

methods.name: getConstants
methods.description: Returns a collection of supported constants.

methods.name: getExpressionBrackets
methods.description: Returns a collection of supported expression bracket pairs.

methods.name: getFunctionBrackets
methods.description: Returns a collection of supported function bracket pairs.

methods.name: addOperators
methods.description: Adds a collection of operators to the supported operators.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single operator to the supported operators.

methods.name: addFunctions
methods.description: Adds a collection of functions to the supported functions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single function to the supported functions.

methods.name: addConstants
methods.description: Adds a collection of constants to the supported constants.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a single constant to the supported constants.

methods.name: addExpressionBracket
methods.description: Adds a bracket pair to the expression brackets list.

methods.name: addExpressionBrackets
methods.description: Adds multiple bracket pairs to the expression brackets list.

methods.name: addFunctionBracket
methods.description: Adds a bracket pair to the function brackets list.

methods.name: addFunctionBrackets
methods.description: Adds multiple bracket pairs to the function brackets list.

methods.name: setTranslation
methods.description: Sets the translated name for a function or constant, enabling localization.

methods.name: setTranslation
methods.description: Private method setting translation for a given name.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves the translated name for a given original name, defaults to original if not translated.

methods.name: setFunctionArgumentSeparator
methods.description: Sets the separator character used for function arguments, default is ','.

methods.name: getFunctionArgumentSeparator
methods.description: Returns the current function argument separator.
